body:
Thank you for the work on 1.25.0, and for taking in our earlier corrections.
Running it on our test files, we still found one case where the cyclomatic
complexity is one too high.

### The problem

The tokenizer keeps `name?` together when `:`, `,`, `)` or the end of the
source follows, so the optional marker of `name?: T` is not a ternary. A
member name in quotes is left out, and its `?` is counted as a decision:

```ts
function retryAfter(e: unknown) {
  const h = (e as { 'retry-after'?: string })['retry-after'];
  return h || '';
}
```

```
$ lizard optional.ts          # master, 1119db8
       4      3     29      1       4 retryAfter@1-4@optional.ts
```

The CCN is 3 instead of 2: one for `||`, one for the `?` of the type. The same
happens for `o: { "a-b"?: number }` in a parameter type.

### What changes

Only `lizard_languages/typescript.py`. `OPTIONAL_NAME` also accepts a single-
or double-quoted string before the `?`, with the same lookahead. A ternary
after a string, `c ? 'a' : 'b'` or `c?'a':'b'`, is unchanged, because the `?`
there is not followed by `:`, `,` or `)`. With the fix:

```
       4      2     28      1       4 retryAfter@1-4@optional.ts
```

The token count drops by one because `'retry-after'?` is now one token, as
`name?` already is.

### How it is tested

`test_optional_quoted_member_is_not_a_ternary` in
`test/test_languages/testOptionalOperators.py`, for `.ts` and `.tsx`: a quoted
optional class field, a quoted optional member in a parameter type and in an
`as` type, and a ternary between strings written without spaces. Both cases
fail on `master` without the change. The full suite passes on the branch:
`python -m pytest` gives 2928 passed, 7 skipped. pycodestyle was not available
here; the changed lines stay within the 120 columns of `setup.cfg`.

### Performance

The added alternative is tried first at each quote, so a string literal is
scanned once more when no `?` follows it. Measured with
`.agents/skills/lizard-process-pr/scripts/paired_benchmark.py`, workload
`api`, on a fixed corpus of 223 JavaScript and 201 TypeScript files (about
65,000 NLOC), against `master` 1119db8: the paired 95% interval of the
slowdown is 1.00% to 1.19%, under the 3% bound. The measurement ran with a
local Python 3.13 virtual environment, not in the Nix environment, which was
not available here.

### What does not change

Optional markers written with a space, `'a' ?: T`, and the `?` of mapped
types, `[K in T]?: V`, are read as before.

Thanks for maintaining lizard and for taking the time to look at this.
title: Do not count the optional marker of a quoted TypeScript member as a ternary
